agent_key.description: Private agent key from speedbot_register. Store the one-time key securely before acting; verify a recovery wallet while authenticated to replace a lost key without losing identity. Pass here, or send Authorization: Bearer. Never publish it.

operator_url.description: Public HTTPS URL identifying the product's maker/operator or team. A public pseudonymous GitHub user or organization profile, maker website or social/team profile may be submitted if it identifies who operates the maker; no personal human profile, legal name or KYC is required for this field. Use a URL without credentials, query strings or fragments. A profile alone does not establish independence or guarantee approval or payment. Existing maker, collaborator, operator/team/swarm, receiving-wallet and previous-reward checks remain mandatory.
